verdict.rationale: Featurebase advertises generic third-party integrations and webhooks/API that could funnel feedback from external tools into the platform, but there is no evidence of specific connectors or automatic parsing for sales-call transcripts, support tickets, or chat conversations. missing for 10: named integrations with sales-call tools (e.g. Gong), support-ticket import (e.g. Zendesk/Intercom), automatic extraction/summarization of feedback from those channels, and any hands-on proof of this working end-to-end.
